name: Distinct mode selection and entry
description: Each dashboard choice loads its own named rules and arena behavior.
steps: Select Career, enter, then return to the dashboard
expected: Each selection opens the matching mode with its own objective and HUD.

name: Career mission progression
description: Career uses a moving gate and a five-return mission objective.
steps: Start a run and return the ball five times
expected: Mission progress advances to five and the sector increases.

name: Adaptive AI Rival duel
description: Rival mode tracks paddle positions and uses that history to counter repeated side bias.
steps: Repeatedly position the paddle toward one side
expected: The opponent uses the recent player-position average to adjust its interception target.

name: Free Play sandbox settings and target practice
description: Free Play exposes adjustable training settings and a moving target ring.
steps: Adjust ball speed and paddle width
Enter the arena and hit the moving target
expected: Settings affect the run, target hits award bonus points, and a miss restarts practice without reducing lives.

name: Boss Rush health and phases
description: Boss Rush begins with a boss encounter and escalates its movement pattern as health falls.
steps: Start and return shots to the boss
Continue until boss health reaches each phase threshold
expected: The boss health bar falls, critical returns deal extra damage, and boss movement accelerates across three phases.
